constraints.description: The smoke scripts pass plaintext values and keys on command lines; bash tracing would print them.
shouldNotMatch: # never set -x here: values are on the command line

constraints.description: make smoke must run under macOS's bash 3.2; associative arrays, mapfile/readarray, and case-modification expansions are bash 4.
Every WP-CLI call goes through the WP array (pinned phar, --path, display_errors=stderr), never a system wp.
shouldNotMatch: # wp core download runs from the pinned phar

constraints.description: The smoke scripts are dependency-free beyond wp and php and run unchanged on a CI runner with no Docker; wp-env is only ever the caller.
shouldMatch: npx @wordpress/env run cli wp plugin list
shouldNotMatch: # its own install rather than wp-env's shared wp-content

constraints.description: The smoke install drops and recreates its database; it must never default to or be assigned the PHPUnit suite's wordpress_test. A comparison that refuses it is allowed.

A TAP diagnostic may show the exit status and a stderr excerpt; it never shows a command's stdout, a value, or a key -- including the suite's lower-case locals (v1, v2, vr, vd, old, new, porcelain_out), the exact names VN and VS, OUT/VALUE/KEY/OLD/NEW, and any interpolated identifier containing 'key' or 'value' in any letter case (current_key, previous_key, some_value, ...) -- because for --reveal that is the plaintext.
shouldNotMatch: not_ok "$desc" "output length ${#OUT} did not match expected length ${#expected}: $desc"
not_ok "secret $expected_sub synopsis flags match the table" \

constraints.description: Never destroy this worktree's wp-env; it is shared with the operator's other sessions (docs/SPEC.md section 7).
This worktree's wp-env ports live only in the git-ignored .wp-env.override.json; nothing tracked may depend on them.
Publishing and tagging happen after merge, by a human (docs/SPEC.md section 3, Never publish). docs-publish.yml is the one sanctioned publisher and is not scanned.
Every GitHub Action is pinned by full 40-hex commit SHA, never a tag (ci.yml header).
There is no filter anywhere in core-bound code (docs/spec/retrieval.md). The architecture test forbids the string; this catches the call shape early.
shouldNotMatch: // hooks: one action, never a filter

constraints.description: src/ carries no function_exists()/class_exists() guard on its own wp_*/WP_* symbols; the no-op decision lives only in secrets-api.php.
Every phpcs:ignore / phpcs:disable carries a ' -- reason' on the same line (docs/SPEC.md section 3, Tests only get stronger).
shouldNotMatch: WP_CLI::line( $x ); // phpcs:ignore WordPress.PHP.DiscouragedPHPFunctions.obfuscation_base64_encode -- encoding key bytes for display, not obfuscating code.
// phpcs:disable WordPress.Security.EscapeOutput -- TAP output, not HTML.
